name: Temporal Distortion
summary: Words fall slower for a while.
description: Words fall slower for 8 seconds. Each cast adds its own slow: two at once are slower still.

name: Frostbinding
description: Freezes every word in place, and stops new words appearing, for 8 seconds. Casting it again while frozen adds more time, but less each time (8 s, then 5.6, 3.9 …). You can keep typing.

name: Arcane Shield
description: The next 2 words that reach the ward line do no harm. Each cast adds 2 more. Lasts until the end of the level.

name: Chain Lightning
summary: Zaps the lowest word and 3 near it.
description: Strikes the lowest word and arcs to the 3 words nearest it. They score and count toward the level.

name: Transmutation
summary: Shortens long words; easy words for 8 s.
description: Every word of 6+ letters becomes a short one, for good. Then, for 8 seconds, every new word is short and easy (3–5 letters, no rare letters or names). After that, words return to the level’s difficulty.

name: Incineration
summary: Burns every word away for base points.
description: A bailout: burns every word on the field. You get each word's base points (no combo or Clean Streak), but burned words don't count toward the level.

name: Arcane Purge
description: Restores 50% of your ward (up to full), and every word loses the extra speed your mistakes gave it. The same in Normal and Hardcore.

name: Harvest
summary: Claims every word on screen, with your multipliers.
description: Claims every word on the field: they all count toward the level, for half points × your combo and Clean Streak. Your combo and streak stay as they are.
